_source.title: 使用复用模块 UUID 获取复用模块文件
_source.remarks.text.0: 可以使用 {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} 接口将文件导出到本地文件系统
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意：本接口需要启用 **团队模块 \> 下载模块** 权限，没有权限调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.libraryUuid: 库 UUID，可以使用 {@link LIB_LibrariesList} 内的接口获取，如若不传入，则为系统库
_source.returns: 复用模块文件数据，`undefined` 表示数据获取失败

title: Use reuse block UUID get reuse block file
remarks.text.0: You can use {@link SYS_FileSystem.saveFile} API export the file to the local file system
remarks.text.1: Note: This API requires the **Team Module > Download Module** permission. Calling it without permission will always `throw Error`
params.libraryUuid: Library UUID. It can be obtained using the APIs in {@link LIB_LibrariesList}. If not passed in, it is the system library
returns: Reuse block file data, `undefined` indicates that the data retrieval failed
